name: visual-check
description: Per-change visual check for UI work: render the touched routes on the merge base and on the working tree in one pinned image, read the diff and the axe/console/overflow deltas, and write the PR's Visual check section. Also README and landing-page screenshots from the same pipeline (visual-kit).
